title: Lunchline partners
description: A team section built around one group photo. On wide screens the photo fills the window, a light heading with a hand-drawn underline sits top-left, and each person carries a small + square with a handwritten 'meet …' tag; clicking opens a cream bio card (handwritten name, tracked role, biography, scribble link) from that corner while the + turns to ×. On phones each person is stacked: a square portrait, then the same bio. The heading's letters rise in as it scrolls into view.
notes: the bio cards are <details> elements: no JavaScript, keyboard-accessible
set each person's x/y (percent of the photo) and side to place their + on the photo; wide screens crop the photo like object-fit: cover, so keep people near the centre
names, tags and the heading underline use the theme's --typeface-hand when it has one (lunchline-theme: Reenie Beanie)
the heading sits over the top of the photo in ink: choose a photo with a light sky or band there
